missing-iat-401.reason: Go's REST chain accepts a signed access token without iat; Rust answers 401 (RequireAuth bytes) because the revocation watermark compares iat. Every first-party mint sets iat (Go IssueDriveNativeToken jwt.go:181, Rust drive_token.rs:29).
missing-iat-401.review: Fable plan review #354 (divergence rulings: missing iat -> 401 approved), PLAN-354-v2 section A.1 row 7; plan header lists it as an owner-approved divergence
missing-iat-401.review_reference: FABLE-REVIEW-353-354-365-367.md, PLAN 354 divergence rulings; FABLE-CODE-354B0.md follow-up 3 (four approved entries)

uid-not-positive-401.reason: Go accepts a signed access token whose uid is missing or <= 0 (handler-dependent); Rust answers 401 (UnservedSubject), never remapped to the Basic/Negotiate fallback.
uid-not-positive-401.review: Fable plan review #354 (uid <= 0 -> 401 approved, with finding 3); PLAN-354-v2 section A.1 row 8
uid-not-positive-401.review_reference: FABLE-REVIEW-353-354-365-367.md, PLAN 354 divergence rulings; FABLE-CODE-354B0.md follow-up 3

precondition-read-503.reason: Go keeps flags and the denylist in memory; Rust reads registry, caller, roles and guest revocation per request and answers 503 (guestgate bytes) when a read fails, instead of forwarding to Go. Reachable only after a verified token, so it is no unauthenticated oracle; registry_state.mode is CHECK-constrained (V183), so no stored mode gives a permanent 503.
precondition-read-503.review: Fable plan review #354 (503 on precondition read failure approved); PLAN-354-v2 section A.1 row 15
precondition-read-503.review_reference: FABLE-REVIEW-353-354-365-367.md, PLAN 354 divergence rulings; FABLE-CODE-354B0.md follow-up 3
precondition-read-503.test: setjoin-authz admit_db fault_* cases (registry, caller, roles, guest revocation, verify timeout)

front-door-revocation-read-503.reason: Go answers from its in-memory revocation set; Rust's front door reads revocations from the DB and answers 503 when that read fails (LocalRust targets with requires_session), after the CAE cold-denylist answer.
front-door-revocation-read-503.review: Fable code review #354 B0 (PR #380) lists it among the four approved entries; the written plan-review ruling names only the first three
